highlights: grh-lean 仓库公开了 GRH 的 Lean 4 证明精简版，基于 Levent Alpöge 与 Claude 的证明，目前只通过了机器检查。
Anthropic 把 Messages API 从 Python 迁到 Rust，每个请求的 CPU 用量降低约 70%；百度放出 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview，280B 总参数、14B 激活。

items.title: grh-lean 公开广义黎曼猜想的 Lean 4 证明精简版
items.summary: 这个仓库给出黎曼猜想和狄利克雷 L 函数广义黎曼猜想（GRH）的 Lean 4 证明，基于 Mathlib；证明以 Levent Alpöge 与 Claude 的版本为基础，由作者和 Anthropic 的同事及 Claude 合作缩短，可读版约 300,000 行，紧凑版约 76,000 行。README 说明它目前只通过了机器检查，还没有数学家通读，也没有配套论文。对关注 AI 做形式化数学的开发者，这是一个可以在本地构建复现的完整工程样本。

evidence.quote: A Lean 4 proof of the Riemann Hypothesis and of the Generalized Riemann Hypothesis for Dirichlet L-functions, built on Mathlib
The proof is based on Levent Alpöge's, with Claude
This repository is a shorter version, produced in collaboration with my colleagues at Anthropic, and Claude. Two editions grh/ : readable edition, about 300,000 lines.
the same five theorems, about 76,000 lines.
The proof has passed machine checks only, listed in each folder's README. No mathematician has read it through, and no paper comes with it.

items.title: Anthropic 把 Messages API 从 Python 迁到 Rust
items.summary: Anthropic 介绍了 Messages API 的迁移：新版每个请求的 CPU 用量降低约 70%，首 token 中位延迟降低约 20%，过程中服务没有下线、功能开发也没有冻结。做法是在生产流量上对比新旧版本、找出差异并自动派 agent 修复，文章的结论是验证取代写代码成了瓶颈。想用 AI 做大型重写的团队，可以参考它“以生产系统为对照”的验证方法。

evidence.quote: This allowed us to ship an API on Rust that uses about 70% less CPU per request and cuts median time to first token by about 20% without ever taking the service offline or freezing feature development.
helped us test the new Rust version on production traffic, find where it differed, and automatically dispatch agents to fix those differences.
Verification, not generation, had become the bottleneck.

items.title: 百度发布 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview：280B 总参数、14B 激活
items.summary: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview 是基于 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base 的首个后训练模型，MoE 架构，上下文窗口 1M token，mid-training 把训练上下文从 128K 扩展到 1M，并加了 DSpark 草稿头做投机解码。官方说明它是后训练的中间检查点，训练还没结束。架构和 tokenizer 与 Base 相同，基于 Base 的工具链可以直接沿用。

evidence.quote: ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview is the first post-trained model built on ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base , which we released earlier. It is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model with 280B total parameters, 14B of them active per token , and a 1M-token context window .
mid-training also extends the training context length from 128K to 1M tokens.
ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview is an intermediate checkpoint from post-training.
ERNIE 5.5 Flash Preview keeps the architecture of ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base and adds a DSpark draft head for speculative decoding.
The architecture and tokenizer match ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, so tooling built for the Base model carries over.

items.title: LlamaIndex 发布文档解析模型 OCRia-1 与 CPU 版 OCRia-nano-1
items.summary: OCRia-1 从 Qwen3.5-4B 起步训练，是 4B 文档解析 VLM，把页面图像转成 Markdown（表格用 HTML），ParseBench 2 得分 85.24；OCRia-nano-1 是从它蒸馏出的 8.1M 参数 CPU 流水线，在 LiteParse 里运行，ParseBench-2 得分 59.2，16 vCPU 上每秒 27.8 页。OCRia-1 用基于 Open RAIL-M 的自有许可，年营收或融资总额达到 $2M 的机构商用需要另购授权。

evidence.quote: OCRia-1 is a 4B vision-language model for document parsing from LlamaIndex . It reads a page image and writes the page as Markdown, with tables in HTML
OCRia-1 starts from Qwen3.5-4B .
ParseBench 2 6 4,317 85.24 7 of 61 1 of 23
Free for personal use, and for commercial use by organizations under $2M in annual revenue and under $2M in total funding. Commercial license needed above those thresholds
OCRia-nano-1 is an 8.1M-parameter model pipeline for document parsing on CPU from LlamaIndex .
it runs inside LiteParse , the open-source local document parser. Its models are distilled from OCRia-1
Accuracy: 59.2 on ParseBench-2 , ahead of the CPU parsers Indra (55.1) and Marker (52.5).
Speed: 27.8 pages per second on 16 vCPUs
AI Pubs Open RAIL-M

items.title: KRAFTON 放出 Raon-1 mini 权重：30B-A4B MoE
items.summary: 继预览版之后，KRAFTON AI 在 Hugging Face 放出 Raon-1 mini：从头训练的 30B-A4B MoE 模型，Apache 2.0 许可，原生支持 262,144 token 上下文，训练语言包括韩语、英语、日语、中文等。官方给出 AIME 2026 96.7、GPQA Diamond 86.0。需要可商用、韩语能力强的中等规模开放模型时可以考虑。

evidence.quote: Raon-1 mini is a 30B-A4B Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model, designed and trained from scratch by KRAFTON AI .
it is released under the Apache 2.0 license .
Natively supports up to 262,144 tokens of context.
Trained on Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese, Spanish, French, and Thai.
Scores 96.7 on AIME 2026, 87.1 on HMMT Feb 2026 and 86.0 on GPQA Diamond.
Raon-1 mini (30B-A4B) Raon-1 mini preview

items.title: Hugging Face 用编码 agent 把 Inkling 2 Mini 单卡解码提速 40%
items.summary: Hugging Face 让一个带 inference-optimisation skill 的编码 agent 在单张 RTX PRO 6000 96 GB 上调参一下午，单用户解码从 136 提到 190.6 tok/s，8 用户总吞吐从约 570 提到 716 tok/s，用的是 vLLM nightly 加 DSpark 投机解码。官方服务配方针对 sm100，这篇补上了 sm120 显卡的做法，日志和脚本都已公开，可以照着复现。

evidence.quote: We wanted to see how fast we could serve it on a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 96 GB
we gave a coding agent the inference-optimisation skill, the hf CLI, and access to Hugging Face Jobs , and let it run experiments for an afternoon.
single-user decode went from 136 to 190.6 tok/s (+40%)
8-user aggregate throughput went from ~570 to 716 tok/s (+26%) using vLLM nightly with DSpark speculative decoding.
the published serving recipes target NVIDIA B200 and GB300 GPUs ( sm100 ), leaving out sm120 cards like the NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000
All logs, scripts, and raw measurements are in NielsRogge/inkling-2-mini-hillclimb .

items.title: RLVB：用可验证的信念奖励治 agent“偷懒”抢答
items.summary: 长任务 agent 常在证据不足时就给出答案；RLVB 在训练时由模拟器算出答案的精确后验，证据不够时奖励继续探索、足够时奖励作答，不需要裁判、critic 或奖励模型。在三个 VLM、三个基准的九组设置里平均提升 17.1%，比用 LLM 裁判过程奖励的 PPO 高 9.3%，GPU 时少 1.6 倍。给 agent 训练提供了一种不靠 LLM 裁判的过程信号。

evidence.quote: RLVB improves the base model in all nine settings, by 17.1% on average.
RLVB also outperforms PPO with a process reward from an LLM judge by 9.3% on average while using 1.6 times fewer GPU-hours.

items.title: NightWatch：给电脑操作 agent 加一个 0.8B 的实时“看守”
items.summary: 电脑操作 agent 靠离散截图感知屏幕，推理延迟会让动作基于过时状态；NightWatch 用轻量的 NightWatch-0.8B 持续监控界面，不改 agent 的模型、提示词和动作空间。在 OSWorld 上非推理耗时减少 33%、浪费时间减少 53%，成功率持平；DynaCU-Bench 成功率从 39.5% 提到 44.2%。它是即插即用的，可以直接挂到现有 agent 上。

evidence.quote: a plug-and-play framework that endows any CUA with continuous, temporally grounded perception without changing the agent's model, prompt, or action space.
reduces non-reasoning wall-clock time by 33% and wasted time by 53% on OSWorld while keeping task success on par, raises success on DynaCU-Bench from 39.5% to 44.2%

items.title: LoomFormer：让注意力头逐 token 重连回路
items.summary: loom attention 让每个头先对前面各头的输出做“纵向”注意力，再对 token 做常规注意力，用逐 token 的矩阵记忆当第二条残差流。论文称 LoomFormer 能追平多用 3 倍以上算力训练的 Transformer；同样 300B tokens、只多 2% FLOPs，LoomPythia-2.8B 在 0-shot 上追平、5-shot 上超过 Pythia-12B。是值得关注的架构改动方向。

evidence.quote: LoomFormer matches Transformers trained with over 3x compute

trained on the same 300B tokens with only 2% extra FLOPs, LoomPythia-2.8B achieves ~1.6x the average downstream gain of mHC-Pythia-2.8B over Pythia-2.8B, and matches (0-shot) or surpasses (5-shot) Pythia-12B.

items.title: Qwen-Image-HD：分块自回归生成 4K 图像
items.summary: Qwen-Image-HD 把 Qwen-Image 2.0 改成按 1K 分块、以上方和左侧高清块及历史缩略图为条件逐块生成，避免整图高分辨率微调的高算力和重复条纹。在 Qwen-Image-Bench 4K 上整体优于 FLUX-3-Image-Klein 直接出 4K，训练算力也比整图 4K 微调更低。另有 Wavefront-AutoRegressive 调度，把同一反对角线上的块分到多卡并行，降低单图延迟。

evidence.quote: On Qwen-Image-Bench at 4K, Qwen-Image-HD achieves stronger overall evaluation performance than direct 4K generation with FLUX-3-Image-Klein.

items.title: Google 开源社交推理评测框架，考 AI 助手能否透过用户叙述推断真相
items.summary: 框架用多智能体模拟生成带隐藏动机的场景，测了 12 个 LLM，发现模型当助手时明显不如直接旁观准确；框架和 20K 多条样本已开源。

evidence.quote: We apply it to 12 LLMs and isolate several key factors
We open-source the framework and a dataset with over 20K generated examples for running experiments.
the model is significantly more accurate at predicting the verifiable ground truth than when the same model acts as an assistant talking strictly to the user.

items.title: langchain-anthropic 1.7.13 支持传入自定义 HTTP 和 SDK 客户端
items.summary: langchain-anthropic 1.7.13 现在可以接收自定义的 HTTP 客户端和 SDK 客户端，同时刷新了模型档案数据。

items.title: SpecEngineeringBench：编码 agent 写的测试能跑通，却很少抓到缺陷
items.summary: 基准含 78 个 Python 仓库的 100 个实例，七个前沿编码 agent 的 Head Pass Rate 达 91.47%，Fail-to-Pass Rate 只有 26.36%。

items.title: ACAP：把一台机器人拆成多个异步编码 agent 来控制
items.summary: 由一个 hyper-agent 分配任务、协调依赖，72 次真机实验中任务时间比单 agent 方案减少 28.2%。

items.title: CUA-SEE：随 agent 一起进化的电脑操作评测环境
items.summary: 根据 rollout 证据同时演化任务和可执行验证器，缓解静态基准难度封顶、诊断粒度粗的问题。
